description: The context/value associations of the UBL example world, made by tools/build_codelists.py from world/codelists/lists.json. Every code element is checked against the list its context names; where a context names several lists, the code's listID chooses one. An identifier element that holds a code (TaxCategory/ID, Language/ID, AttributeID ...) is checked the same way, its schemeID naming the list. They replace UBL's own associations for the world's documents.
